mood.VERY_LOW: I know today feels heavy. Be gentle with yourself — a small break is part of progress too. I'm here with you.
mood.SERIOUS_DISTRESS: You do not have to carry this alone. Contact someone you trust now; if you may hurt yourself, call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department.
mood.LOW: Hard days happen. Just take one small step today and leave the rest for tomorrow. I'm here.
mood.OKAY: You're doing fine. Accept today as it is and do what you can — that's enough.
mood.GOOD: Your energy is up, great! Carry this motivation into today's plan — you'll get a lot done.
mood.GREAT: So glad you feel amazing! Use this momentum to give yourself a strong push today.

motivation.START: Take one small step today — that's enough. I'm here with you.
